title: Completion, Final Walkthrough and Contract Closing for Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
## Completion

Work on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract starts and completes only as recorded by the installer.

## Final walkthrough and punch list

On a program that requires a final walkthrough, a walkthrough is held at completion and any open items are recorded as a punch list. The punch list is resolved within the program's punch-list resolution days of completion, after which the withheld amount is due.

> While the punch list is open the customer may withhold up to the program's punch-list holdback percentage of the contract price from the final payment — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the final settlement payment.

## Balance due

The remaining balance is due within the program's final payment days after the completion date.

## Closing

A contract closes when its balance due is 0.00 and the customer has signed the completion certificate, or when the program's completion sign-off days have passed since the completion date without a signed certificate. A contract with a balance owed never closes. An overpayment found at closing is refunded to the tender it was paid with, with the refund reason "overpayment".

| Balance due | Completion certificate | Sign-off period since completion | Closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | signed | any | yes |
| 0.00 | unsigned | passed | yes |
| amount owed | signed or unsigned | any | no, never while a balance is owed |

*Hypothetical:* on a program with a 7-day sign-off period, a job completed on 2 August with a balance of 0.00 and an unsigned certificate closes once 7 days have passed since 2 August, on 9 August.

superseded_clauses: while punch_list_open is true the customer may withhold up to punch_list_holdback_pct percent of the contract price from the final payment
